peers.name: architect
peers.purpose: Ask about the design when the ticket does not settle it.

commands:
/var/folders/4g/s95glx9x6n71bq4hc08ly2gm0000gn/T/m2-await-bMAHhg/bin/wf send architect --await-reply <<'WF_MSG'
Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or in the queue. NOTES.md says retry design is undecided. charge() currently constructs HttpClient on every call, posts /charges, throws on status >=500, and returns response.body.id. I need your decision (client or queue) before writing the short plan. Please include any retry/idempotency constraints.
WF_MSG
turns.final: Awaiting the architect’s decision on whether retries belong in the client or the queue.

calls.text: Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or in the queue. NOTES.md says retry design is undecided. charge() currently constructs HttpClient on every call, posts /charges, throws on status >=500, and returns response.body.id. I need your decision (client or queue) before writing the short plan. Please include any retry/idempotency constraints.

turns.final: Submitted the plan: retries live in the queue, as the architect decided; the shared client and batch path remain single-attempt.

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Keep charge() and the shared HTTP client single-attempt so the batch path never retries. Add bounded retries with exponential backoff and jitter in the queue worker for transient failures, including 5xx; do not retry permanent failures. Reuse a stable payment idempotency key across attempts, verifying provider support before enabling retries to prevent duplicate charges. Test transient recovery, retry exhaustion, permanent failures, idempotency, and that the batch path remains single-attempt."}
